shared_speaker.note: cos = video-centroid cosine under the two audit embeddings (TitaNet-L, CAM++); percentile_in_split_half_null is in percent of same-video split-half cosines below it. These are the closest cross-channel pairs in the corpus, and the pilot video's best cosine to its own channel is lower, so it was split off; descriptive only, not a speaker verification.
